entries.title: D
entries.definitive_edition: D: The Game modern PC rerelease

emulation.emulator: Native modern PC package; DOSBox for the DOS version; Mednafen/Saturn/3DO emulators only for historical ports
emulation.notes: Use the Steam/GOG/ZOOM PC release for the primary route. Emulate console versions only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Packaged PC presentation with modern storefront compatibility; console ports are historical alternatives.

primary.version: D: The Game modern PC rerelease
primary.why: The modern PC rerelease on Steam/GOG/ZOOM is the best official access route because it packages the classic PC version for current computers, while the older console ports remain historical alternatives.
primary.how_to_play: Buy D: The Game on Steam, GOG, or ZOOM Platform and look into display or compatibility tweaks if needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a compatibility-focused rerelease of the classic game, not a remake or asset-level remaster.

entries.title: Enemy Zero

emulation.emulator: Native/compatibility-fixed Windows PC; Mednafen or Kronos for Saturn
emulation.notes: Try the PC port first if owned and compatible. Use Saturn emulation for the original version.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Updated PC port presentation if compatibility works; otherwise original Saturn presentation with emulator-side improvements.

primary.why: Enemy Zero shipped on Saturn and later Windows; the PC version is an updated port of the Saturn game, making it the best fidelity target if an owned copy can be run.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows PC copy with compatibility guidance. Use the Saturn release through Mednafen or another accurate Saturn emulator if the PC port is not practical.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or current digital rerelease was identified.

entries.title: D2

emulation.notes: Use a Dreamcast emulator with an owned copy for high-resolution capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Dreamcast presentation with emulator-side resolution and capture improvements.

primary.why: D2 is a Dreamcast-only Warp survival-horror/adventure game with no sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease, so the original Dreamcast version is the complete canonical release.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Dreamcast copy on original hardware, or use Flycast/Redream with an owned disc image for clean capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease was identified.
